lane4_headline: BANKED the US Penrose micro-arc at county grain: NY jail census (nymx-kgkn, 1,924 rows) + certified psychiatric beds (2g9y-7kqm, 94 rows / 4,936 beds / 41 counties) + Census PEP pops (krt9-ym2k, 3,906 rows)

STATIC TEST (36 dual-grain counties): population-blind cross-section r=+0.626 p=4e-5 (positive = county scale confound); per-capita r=+0.286 p=0.09 — the naive inverse Penrose sign does NOT appear in the within-state cross-section
CHANGE TEST 2000->2024: ~zero (r=+0.19 p=0.27) — NY's 2020-2021 jail collapse (-49%, bail reform+COVID) is the dominant first axis, not beds

TIME-ARC: jail stock +13% 1997->2010 while NY holds the nation's max state-psychiatric-hospital count (23) => NY's bed-to-jail swap is largely PRE-1997-complete at the county margin; post-2019 the axis is policy, not beds

HONEST-NULLS banked: psych-bed capacity time-series NOT capturable keyless on Socrata (4 datasets probed: 2dbc-sqe7 acute-only, 4uks/xgig utilization-not-capacity, CON-not-capacity) — bed-arc half runs on a fixed 2026 snapshot, tagged per row; NYC aggregate rows excluded from county tests, flagged
BOARD-IN bridge banked (boarded_in_psych column) for the next pass — the direct jail->psych flow measure at facility-year grain
lane5_headline: REPLICATED the PMID-42750086 stratification design at the mortality margin: NRI FY2024 SMHA per-capita (Table 1, 52 jurisdictions, internal-consistency max error <7e-5) x CDC Mapping-IOV state rates (fpsi-y8tj, 51 jurisdictions, 2019-2024)
18 of 18 Mann-Whitney cells NON-SIGNIFICANT (suicide/homicide/overdose x 6 years; p range 0.15-0.90) — the anchor's null verdict replicates

SUICIDE runs opposite the naive direction (bottom-10 spend states HIGHER suicide in 6/6 years, ~+2.5/100k, p=0.24-0.51, nonsig) — directional trend like the paper's, in the opposite class-expected sign
OVERDOSE: top-spend states higher in 6/6 (up to +6.5/100k, p=0.31-0.90) — fentanyl supply wave dominates SMHA-spend rank

funding-not-beds adjacent check: NRI Table 3 split shows hospital-capacity share is organization-choice-mediated (13 states run hospitals outside the SMHA; MI 97.7% hospital-share at lowest total spend; OR $524 community vs IA $14.7 total) — replicates rank-5 null class
HONEST-NULLS banked: BRFSS cost-barriers question absent from keyless Socrata layer (5eh7-pjx8 probed); parity stratification arm behind NRI profiles sign-in this pass
